frm.name: set_value
frm.signature: frm.set_value(fieldname: string | object, value?: any): Promise<void>
frm.returnDescription: Promise that resolves once the field value has been set and UI inputs re-rendered.
frm.docstring: Sets the value of a field on the current open Form and automatically updates the screen UI. If passing an object, it sets multiple fields simultaneously.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname to update or dictionary object of multiple field-value pairs.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to assign (omit if fieldname is an object).

frm.name: get_value
frm.returnDescription: Current field value from the form document (same as frm.doc[fieldname]).
frm.docstring: Retrieves the current in-memory value of a field from the open form.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: The fieldname of the field to read.

frm.name: save
frm.signature: frm.save(action?: string, callback?: () => void, btn?: any): Promise<void>
frm.returnDescription: Promise resolving after document save completes.
frm.docstring: Triggers the standard form save or submit action and runs client validation handlers.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Form action lifecycle command to trigger.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback invoked after successful save response.

parameters.name: btn
parameters.description: Triggering button element to freeze while saving.

frm.name: refresh
frm.docstring: Re-renders the form UI and triggers the `refresh` event handler.

frm.name: refresh_field
frm.docstring: Re-renders and updates a specific field's input control on the screen. Call this after directly modifying frm.doc.fieldname or child tables.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: The fieldname of the field or child table to re-render.

frm.name: set_df_property
frm.signature: frm.set_df_property(fieldname: string, property: string, value: any)
frm.docstring: Dynamically changes a DocField property (such as read_only, reqd, hidden, options, label, description) on the form.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Target fieldname.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: DocField property name.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New property value.

frm.name: toggle_display
frm.signature: frm.toggle_display(fieldname: string | string[], show: boolean): void
frm.docstring: Shows or hides one or more form fields or sections dynamically based on condition evaluation. Accepts either a single field name or an array of field names.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Field name or array of field names to toggle.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: True to display fields; False to hide them.

frm.name: toggle_enable
frm.docstring: Enables or disables (read-only) one or more fields based on a condition.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname or array of fieldnames.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: True to enable (editable), False to disable.

frm.name: toggle_reqd
frm.signature: frm.toggle_reqd(fieldname: string | string[], reqd: boolean): void
frm.docstring: Dynamically toggles mandatory / required status on fields. If `reqd` is true, the user will be blocked from saving until the field is filled.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Field name or list of field names.

parameters.name: reqd
parameters.description: True to make mandatory; False to make optional.

frm.name: add_custom_button
frm.signature: frm.add_custom_button(label: string, action: () => void, group?: string): JQuery
frm.returnDescription: The jQuery DOM element of the created button.
frm.docstring: Adds a custom action button in the form header toolbar. You can group multiple buttons together under a dropdown menu (e.g. "Create" -> "Invoice", "Create" -> "Delivery Note") and style them as primary or danger buttons.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Display label for the button.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: JavaScript click handler callback function.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Parent dropdown menu name to group this button under.

frm.name: clear_custom_buttons
frm.docstring: Removes all custom buttons added to the form toolbar.

frm.name: set_query
frm.signature: frm.set_query(fieldname: string, table_fieldname?: string, query_fn: () => object | string): void
frm.docstring: Applies dynamic filter conditions to a Link field popup lookup dialog. Crucial for filtering dependent dropdowns (e.g. showing only Contacts that belong to the currently selected Customer, or filtering Items by Warehouse).

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: The Link fieldname to filter.

parameters.name: table_fieldname
parameters.description: Child table fieldname (if filtering a link field inside a child grid table).

parameters.name: query_fn
parameters.description: Callback function returning filter object or custom Python query method path.

frm.name: is_new
frm.returnDescription: True if the document has not yet been saved into database.
frm.docstring: Checks if the current open form is a brand new unsaved record.

frm.name: is_dirty
frm.returnDescription: True if there are unsaved modifications on the form.
frm.docstring: Returns True if any field on the form has been modified since last save.

frm.name: add_child
frm.returnDescription: The newly added child row object.
frm.docstring: Adds a new row to a child Table field on the current form.

parameters.name: table_fieldname
parameters.description: Child Table fieldname on parent DocType.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Initial field values assigned to the new child row.

frm.name: set_intro
frm.docstring: Displays a colored notification banner strip at the top of the form.
frm.example: frm.set_intro(__("This document is waiting for Manager Approval"), "orange");

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Banner message text to display above form header.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color theme of alert banner.

frm.name: call
frm.signature: frm.call(method: string, args?: object, callback?: (r: any) => void, btn?: any): Promise<any>
frm.docstring: Invokes a Python controller method defined on this DocType directly for this specific document instance.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Document controller method name or whitelisted API dot-path.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Arguments passed to controller method.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback executed with response payload.

parameters.name: btn
parameters.description: Button element to freeze/animate while executing.

frm.name: reload_doc
frm.docstring: Reloads the current document from the server and refreshes the form interface.

frm.name: print_doc
frm.docstring: Opens the print previewer dialog for this document.

frm.name: email_doc
frm.docstring: Opens the email composer dialog with this document attached as PDF.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Prefilled email message text.

frm.name: change_custom_button_type
frm.signature: frm.change_custom_button_type(label: string, group: string, type: string): void
frm.docstring: Changes visual style / bootstrap color class of a custom button.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Button label.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Button group name or null if top-level.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Bootstrap button styling variant.

frm.name: clear_table
frm.docstring: Removes all child rows from specified child table field.
frm.returnDescription: None (Empties all rows from child table).

parameters.name: table_fieldname
parameters.description: Child Table fieldname to clear.

frm.name: scroll_to_field
frm.docstring: Smoothly scrolls form view to target field input.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Target fieldname to smoothly scroll form viewport into focus.

frm.name: disable_save
frm.docstring: Disables standard Save button in form toolbar.

parameters.name: disable
parameters.description: Set True to hide/disable Save button, False to restore.

frm.name: enable_save
frm.docstring: Re-enables standard Save button in form toolbar.

grid.name: add_new_row
grid.signature: grid.add_new_row(idx?: number, callback?: (row: object) => void): object
grid.returnDescription: The newly created child table grid row instance.
grid.docstring: Programmatically adds a new row to a child table grid and triggers standard row render events. You can specify the row insertion index and a callback function to populate values.

parameters.name: idx
parameters.description: Target index position where the new row should be placed.

grid.name: get_selected
grid.returnDescription: Array of selected row docnames (cdn values).
grid.docstring: Returns the names of all checked / selected rows in the child table grid.

grid.name: grid_rows
grid.docstring: Array of all visible GridRow instances in the child table.

grid.name: refresh
grid.docstring: Re-renders the child table grid rows and totals on screen.

listview.name: refresh
listview.docstring: Re-queries the database and refreshes the ListView table rows.

listview.name: get_checked_items
listview.returnDescription: Array of checked row objects with docname and fields.
listview.docstring: Returns all checked / selected document rows in the ListView.

page.name: set_title
page.docstring: Sets header title text on custom workspace Page.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Display title.

page.name: set_indicator
page.docstring: Displays colored status badge in page navigation bar.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Badge label text.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Badge color.

page.name: add_inner_button
page.signature: page.add_inner_button(label: string, action: () => void, group?: string): any
page.docstring: Adds sub-action button inside page toolbar or dropdown group.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Button label text.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Click event callback handler.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Inner button group dropdown heading.

page.name: add_field
page.docstring: Adds dynamic filter input control into page header toolbar.
page.example: const dateField = page.add_field({ fieldtype: "Date", label: "From Date", fieldname: "from_date" });

parameters.name: df
parameters.description: DocField definition dictionary.

page.name: set_primary_action
page.signature: page.set_primary_action(label: string, action: () => void, icon?: string): any
page.docstring: Configures standard bold primary action button in top right of page.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Button label.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Primary action handler.

parameters.name: icon
parameters.description: FontAwesome icon class name.
